$comment: Editorial fills this in. Paste a Cloudinary delivery URL or a bare public ID into `media` — both work, and the origin is inferred from a pasted URL. Everything except `media` and `collection` is optional; the feed degrades rather than breaks.
$baseUrl_note: The NFL runs a private-CDN Cloudinary, so there is no cloud name in the path. For a shared res.cloudinary.com account use "cloud": "<name>" instead.
$namedTransformations_note: true when the account has Strict Transformations enabled and tx_feed_* have been registered in the console. Run tools/cloudinary-probe.html to find out which.
